title: Ordered completed exchange equals the completion-unit-conjugated ordinary mate
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite normed field extension, put $A=\mathcal O_E$ and fix a uniformizer $\varpi$. Let $k$ have positive prime characteristic different from $\ell$, and let all schemes mentioned be separated and of finite type over $k$. Require explicitly that each scheme is Noetherian and finite dimensional and that $\ell$ is invertible in its local rings. On the small pro-etale site put $A_T=\varprojlim_n(A/\varpi^n)_T$ and $E_T(V)=C(|V|,E)$, with pointwise operations. Use the integral category $\mathcal I_T=\Dbc(T,A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] and its raw scalar localization $\mathcal R_T=\mathcal I_T[1/\varpi]$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Let $\square=(f,f',g,g')$ be a cartesian square of these schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f:X\to Y$ proper, and let $K\in\mathcal I_X$, retaining any choice of its compatible etale-origin witnesses. Put $M=Lg_A^*Rf_{*,A}K$ and $N=Rf'_{*,A}Lg_A'^*K$, using ordinary ambient operations, and let $e:M\to N$ be their unit-square-counit mate [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. Let $\gamma_g:M\to Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_{*,A}K$ and $\gamma_{g'}:Lg_A'^*K\to Lg'^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K$ be the specified completion units of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. They are isomorphisms and the ordered completed exchange of [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map] satisfies the equality
$$\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{comp}}_{\square,K}=(Rf'_{*,A}\gamma_{g'})\,e\,\gamma_g^{-1}.$$
This is equality for the specified strict-tower map and its actual endpoint comparisons, with no assertion that $e$ or exchange is invertible.

proof.text: The coefficient datum of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] gives finite quotient rings $P_n=A/\varpi^n$ with their unital quotient transitions. By [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image], for every edge $h$ the actual map $c_h:h^{-1}A_T\to A_{T'}$ is an isomorphism, and these isomorphisms carry the finite quotient maps and transitions to the specified ones on $T'$. The tensor formula of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction] therefore reduces module pullback to inverse image and gives its module direct-image adjunction. Exactness follows from [lem-weil-pbc-site-pullback-abelian-exact]: kernels and cokernels of module maps have their underlying abelian kernels and cokernels. Thus the generic strict augmentation lemmas below apply. Moreover $\ell$ annihilates $A/(\varpi)$: its extended absolute value is $|\ell|_\ell=\ell^{-1}<1$, so $\ell$ lies in the maximal ideal $(\varpi)$. It is invertible on all four schemes by hypothesis.

proof.text: The base change $f'$ is proper by [lem-weil-pbc-proper-fp-permanence]. Since $Y$ is Noetherian, it is quasi-compact. Apply [lem-sfb-finite-proper-geometric-cd-bound] to $f$: it gives a common bound $e\geq0$ on geometric fibre dimensions. The hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-actual-coefficient-constructible-preservation] now hold, with positive annihilator $\ell$ from step 1; hence the ordinary ambient $Rf_{*,A}K$ belongs to $\mathcal I_Y$. By [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization], its integral category, and that of $K$, are exactly the categories used in [lem-tw-ordinary-completed-integral-pullback]. Apply the latter to $(g,Rf_{*,A}K)$ and $(g',K)$. Both inputs are integral constructible; the schemes are Noetherian, finite dimensional, with $\ell$ invertible. It follows that both $\gamma_g$ and $\gamma_{g'}$ are isomorphisms. They are precisely the units of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]: both constructions apply the same quotient maps to a flat-term K-flat representative and then take the strict derived limit, with the normalized tensor/pullback identifications. This argument requires no $k$-linearity of the arrows and uses no exchange isomorphism.

proof.text:
Put $E_0=Lg_A'^*K$, so $N=Rf'_{*,A}E_0$. For a corner $T$ write $\mathcal R_T(C)$ for its strict quotient-reduction tower and $i_C:\Delta C\to\mathcal R_T(C)$ for its augmentation. Set $F_T=R\lim_T$ and $u_C=F_T(i_C)\lambda_C$, where $\lambda_C:C\to F_T\Delta C$ is the canonical constant-tower map. By [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-pullback-derived-tower], the normalized comparisons give $\tau_g:Lg^*_{\mathrm{Tow}}\mathcal R_Y(Rf_*K)\simeq\mathcal R_{Y'}(M)$ and $t:Lg'^*_{\mathrm{Tow}}\mathcal R_X(K)\simeq\mathcal R_{X'}(E_0)$. Write $S=Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_*K$, $Z=Lg'^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K$, and $j=F_{Y'}(\tau_g):S\simeq F_{Y'}\mathcal R_{Y'}(M)$. The augmentation equation in that lemma and the strict definition of the units in [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] give
$$j\gamma_g=u_M,\qquad F_{X'}(t)\gamma_{g'}=u_{E_0}.$$
These equalities concern the strict augmentations before taking limits, so they do not require derived evaluations to be faithful.

proof.text:
Use [lem-weil-pbc-strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization] with the retained witnesses. It supplies the specified isomorphisms $H:\mathcal R_{Y'}(M)\simeq B_\bullet$ and $H':\mathcal R_{Y'}(N)\simeq D_\bullet$ and, in the derived category of strict towers, the actual equality
$$v'_\bullet=H'\mathcal R_{Y'}(e)H^{-1}.$$
Here $B_\bullet,D_\bullet,v'_\bullet$ are the towers and arrow in the definition of the ordered completed exchange, not newly chosen lifts of their evaluations. If $h_{E_0}:\mathcal R_{Y'}(N)\to Rf'_*^{\mathrm{Tow}}\mathcal R_{X'}(E_0)$ denotes the diagram-site projection mate, the specified target comparison in the same statement reads
$$H'=Rf'_*^{\mathrm{Tow}}(t^{-1})h_{E_0},\qquad D_\bullet=Rf'_*^{\mathrm{Tow}}(Lg'^*_{\mathrm{Tow}}\mathcal R_X(K)).$$
The source comparison is $H$ after $\tau_g$, since its evaluations are the same specified projection maps with their strict diagram-site realization.

proof.text:
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-augmented-diagram-projection-mate] to $f'$ and the unital quotient-algebra tower $((A/\varpi^n)_{Y'})_n$. Its pullback is the quotient tower on $X'$ by the coefficient comparisons in steps 1–2. It states the strict equation
$$h_{E_0}i_N=Rf'_*^{\mathrm{Tow}}(i_{E_0})\chi_{E_0}.$$
Apply the functor $F_{Y'}$ and precompose with $\lambda_N$. Naturality of the direct-image/limit comparison $c$ of [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits], applied to $i_{E_0}$, gives
$$F_{Y'}(h_{E_0})u_N=c_{\mathcal R(E_0)}\,Rf'_*u_{E_0}.$$
Indeed the constant-tower normalization of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-tower-pushforward-normalization] says precisely $F_{Y'}(\chi_{E_0})\lambda_N=c_{\Delta E_0}Rf'_*(\lambda_{E_0})$ under $F_T\Delta\simeq\mathrm{id}$. Substitution into the strict augmentation equation proves the displayed equality with the specified $c$. No completeness or invertibility of $e$ is needed in this calculation.

proof.text:
Let $Q_\bullet=Lg'^*_{\mathrm{Tow}}\mathcal R_X(K)$ and let $c_Q:Rf'_*Z\simeq F_{Y'}D_\bullet$ be exactly the comparison used in [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map]. Naturality of $c$ in [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits] for $t^{-1}:\mathcal R_{X'}(E_0)\to Q_\bullet$ says
$$F_{Y'}(Rf'_*^{\mathrm{Tow}}t^{-1})c_{\mathcal R(E_0)}=c_QRf'_*(F_{X'}t^{-1}).$$
Substitute the formula for $H'$ from step 4 and the equality from step 5. The second unit identity of step 3 yields
$$F_{Y'}(H')u_N=c_QRf'_*\bigl(F_{X'}(t^{-1})u_{E_0}\bigr)=c_QRf'_*(\gamma_{g'}).$$
Thus the target comparison is tied to the actual completion unit, including its normalization.

proof.text:
The quotient augmentation is natural: for the actual morphism $e:M\to N$ one has $\mathcal R_{Y'}(e)i_M=i_N\Delta(e)$. This is tensoring the equation $e\circ1_M=1_N\circ e$ with each unital quotient map, with its actual transitions; it remains true after passing from K-flat representatives to the derived reduction functor of [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-pullback-derived-tower]. Applying [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality] and the natural constant-tower map gives
$$F_{Y'}(\mathcal R_{Y'}(e))u_M=u_Ne.$$
No passage from levelwise equalities to a strict-tower equality is being inferred.

proof.text:
By [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map], with the source identification of step 4, the ordered map is $c_Q^{-1}F_{Y'}(v'_\bullet)F_{Y'}(H)j$. Functoriality [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality] and the strict equality in step 4 cancel the adjacent $F_{Y'}(H^{-1})F_{Y'}(H)$. Consequently steps 3, 7 and 6 give, in this order,
$$\begin{aligned}
\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{comp}}_{\square,K}\gamma_g
 &=c_Q^{-1}F_{Y'}(H')F_{Y'}(\mathcal R_{Y'}(e))u_M\\
 &=c_Q^{-1}F_{Y'}(H')u_Ne\\
 &=Rf'_*(\gamma_{g'})e.
\end{aligned}$$
Postcompose on the input with $\gamma_g^{-1}$, which exists by step 2. This is the required equality for the specified exchange and endpoint maps. The calculation never inverts $e$ or $v'_\bullet$.
